note: Groups and plain descriptions for the flags that the desktop client contains, read from the client of Antigravity 2.35.1. group: the section of the list. basis: "code" when the use was seen in the client code, "name" when the text rests on the flag name and the server value only (the page shows "inferred"). hide: "internal" (works only inside Google) or "noEffect" (no effect in the macOS desktop app); hidden flags are listed at the bottom of the page with text as the reason. keep: true keeps a flag that the scan does not find, because the programs may build its name at run time. evidence: where the use was found, for maintainers. Flags that no program of the client contains are found when the daemon runs (src/usage.mjs) and need no entry here.

title.zh: 插件、技能、MCP 与扩展面板
title.en: Plugins, skills, MCP and side apps

text.zh: 代理改文件时所用「替换内容」工具的参数，例如允许多大的模糊匹配误差、能否只替换成功一部分、是否按行号范围定位。
text.en: Settings for the "replace content" tool that the agent uses to edit files, for example how much fuzzy-match difference is allowed, whether a partial replacement counts as success, and whether line ranges are used.

CASCADE_USE_REPLACE_CONTENT_EDIT_TOOL.evidence: Server value is JSON with max_fuzzy_edit_distance_fraction, allow_partial_replacement_success, use_line_range, fast_apply_fallback_config; language_server has the matching proto fields (exa.cortex_pb replace tool config). main.js only lists it as an ExperimentKey enum value.

text.zh: 代理调用模型失败、或模型输出无效时的重试设置（次数、等待时间），是一段 JSON。空值表示用内置设置。
text.en: Retry settings for the agent when a model call fails or the model output is not valid (number of retries, wait time), as JSON. Empty means the built-in settings.

agent-retry-config.evidence: Bare constant in language_server. Proto exa.cortex_pb.PlannerRetryConfig {api_retry: ModelAPIRetryConfig (max_retries, initial_sleep_duration_ms, exponential_multiplier), model_output_retry}. The link from the flag to this proto is inferred from the name.

text.zh: 把选中的自定义代理（代理定义）改派给另一个代理定义的设置。空值表示不改派。
text.en: Setting that reroutes a selected custom agent (agent definition) to another agent definition. Empty means no reroute.

agent-script-reroute.evidence: Go function cortex/config.GetAgentScriptReroute. 'Agent script' = custom agent definitions (AgentScriptItem, selected_agent_script, GetAgentScripts RPC). 'Reroute' meaning inferred from the name (compare GetDeprecatedModelReroute for models).

text.zh: 插件市场页面「精选」卡片推荐哪些插件；代理的提示词里也会写进这些插件。
text.en: Which plugins the featured cards of the plugin marketplace recommend. The agent's prompt also lists these plugins.

agy-featured-plugins.evidence: Value: JSON cards with customizationIds of marketplace plugins. main.js marketplace page reads featuredCards and shelves; language_server has cortex/mixins/featured_plugins_section.go (NewFeaturedPluginsSection, a prompt section).

text.zh: 服务端下发的公告文字。不为空时，窗口里显示一条可以关掉的公告横幅。
text.en: Announcement text sent by the server. When it is not empty, the window shows it in a banner that you can close.

agy-hub-announcement-message.evidence: main.js: the external app variant sets serviceAnnouncementBannerFeature = sj("agy-hub-announcement-message"); component nnd renders it as a dismissible status banner (data-testid jetbox-service-announcement-banner).

text.zh: 新手引导里可选的角色（如软件工程），以及每个角色对应的界面风格、推荐插件和示例提示。
text.en: The roles offered during onboarding (for example Software Engineering), with the interface style, suggested plugins and example prompts for each role.

agy-onboarding-personas.evidence: Value: JSON personas {id, displayName, skin, description}. Proto OnboardingPersona {id, display_name, description, skin: ProductSkin, suggestions[label, customization_id, prompt]}; RPC GetOnboardingPersonas.

text.zh: 插件市场从哪些地址读取插件目录，每项是「名称=网址」，例如官方目录和合作伙伴目录。
text.en: Where the plugin marketplace loads its plugin catalogs from. Each item is name=URL, for example the official catalog and the partner catalog.

text.zh: 插件市场的分类货架（名称、说明、示例插件）。代理的提示词里也会列出这些货架，让代理在合适时推荐插件。
text.en: The category shelves of the plugin marketplace (name, description, example plugins). The agent's prompt also lists them, so that the agent can suggest a fitting plugin.

agy-plugin-shelves.evidence: Value: JSON shelves {id, displayName, description, position, customizationIds}. Prompt text in language_server: 'The Agent Marketplace groups its plugins into the shelves below... When a plugin clearly fits what the user is working on, suggest it'. main.js marketplace reads shelves.

text.zh: 允许命令安全检查启用试验中的监控规则（检查代理操作是否危险的规则）。
text.en: Lets the command safety check use experimental monitors (rules that check whether an agent action is dangerous).

allow-experimental-monitors.evidence: Field allow_experimental_monitors of exa.cortex_pb.CommandAssessorConfig (with enabled, policy_guardian_config, active_tags, sonar_monitors_config_textproto). Embedded per-model defaults set it true for some models.

text.zh: 允许命令安全检查启用名字带 PSS 的那一组试验监控规则。
text.en: Lets the command safety check use the group of experimental monitors named PSS.

allow-pss-experimental-monitors.evidence: Field allow_pss_experimental_monitors of CommandAssessorConfig, next to allow_experimental_monitors. What PSS stands for was not found in the client.

text.zh: 代理可以不经询问直接运行的命令清单：平时只有 cd；在终端沙箱里还包括 ls、cat、grep、mv、rm 等。
text.en: Commands the agent may run without asking: normally only cd; inside the terminal sandbox also ls, cat, grep, mv, rm and similar commands.

auto-command-config.evidence: Value: JSON {system_allowlist:[cd], sandbox_system_allowlist:[head, tail, mkdir, cd, cp, mv, cat, find, grep, rm, touch, less, clear, ls]}. Proto AutoCommandConfig {enable_model_auto_run, user_allowlist, user_denylist, system_allowlist, sandbox_system_allowlist, system_denylist, ...}.

text.zh: 权限预设「Auto」（自动判断命令能否直接运行）在内部对应哪个预设。
text.en: Which internal preset the Auto permission preset (it decides automatically whether a command may run) maps to.

auto-mode-permission-preset.evidence: Presets in language_server: PERMISSION_PRESET_AUTO/DEFAULT/REQUEST_REVIEW/TURBO/VETTED/NONE. main.js: Auto = 'Automatically decide if commands run.'; it maps both AUTO and VETTED to 'auto'. The reader of the flag was not seen.

text.zh: Best of N（同一任务让几个模型同时做）中每个分支最多进行几轮。对外版本的界面没有 Best of N 入口；语言服务器也读这个值，具体作用没有确认。
text.en: The maximum number of turns for each branch in Best of N (several models do the same task). The public build has no Best of N entry in the interface; the language server also reads the value, and its effect there was not checked.

battle-mode-max-turns.evidence: main.js: UZ("battle-mode-max-turns",0) limits user turns only inside an active battle (ppd). External app variant has no battleModeFeature, so enable-battle-mode yields null (u3d: a??null); composer isBestOfNSupported = !!battleModeFeature && ...; the toggle also needs showInternalModesDropdown. Kept visible by the main session: language_server reads the name in config.augmentConversationalConfigWithExperiment and config.buildDefaultAgent, which are not battle-only by name.

text.zh: 客户端没有代码读取这个开关：名字只出现在程序内置的默认值表里，改了不起作用。
text.en: No client code reads this flag. The name occurs only in a built-in table of default values, so a change has no effect.

battle-winner-survey-percent.evidence: Only occurrence in language_server and agy: quoted key in the embedded default-flag JSON ("battle-winner-survey-percent": 50). No bare string constant; not in ui_all.txt, app.asar or the helpers. The winner survey itself exists in main.js (pendingWinnerSurveyBattleIds).

text.zh: Best of N 默认选用的模型。对外版本没有带 Best of N 的组件，改了没有效果。
text.en: Default model for Best of N. The public build does not include the Best of N component, so it has no effect.

best-of-n-default-model-id.evidence: main.js: sj("best-of-n-default-model-id") picks the default model in Bcd (Best of N model selection), reachable only through the Best of N toggle or nudge. External app variant has no battleModeFeature, so enable-battle-mode yields null (u3d: a??null); composer isBestOfNSupported = !!battleModeFeature && ...; the toggle also needs showInternalModesDropdown.

text.zh: 关掉「建议用 Best of N」的提示后，多少天内不再提示。对外版本不会出现这个提示，改了没有效果。
text.en: Number of days that the "try Best of N" suggestion stays hidden after you close it. The public build never shows this suggestion, so it has no effect.

best-of-nudge-dismiss-cooldown-days.evidence: main.js: UZ("best-of-nudge-dismiss-cooldown-days",10) in the Best of N recommendation banner hook (Dcd); the banner needs isBestOfNSupported. External app variant has no battleModeFeature, so enable-battle-mode yields null (u3d: a??null); composer isBestOfNSupported = !!battleModeFeature && ...; the toggle also needs showInternalModesDropdown.

text.zh: 输入超过多少个字符时，提示改用 Best of N。对外版本不会出现这个提示，改了没有效果。
text.en: Prompt length in characters at which the "try Best of N" suggestion appears. The public build never shows this suggestion, so it has no effect.

best-of-nudge-length-threshold.evidence: main.js: UZ("best-of-nudge-length-threshold",150) in the Best of N recommendation banner hook (Dcd); the banner needs isBestOfNSupported. External app variant has no battleModeFeature, so enable-battle-mode yields null (u3d: a??null); composer isBestOfNSupported = !!battleModeFeature && ...; the toggle also needs showInternalModesDropdown.

text.zh: 浏览器子代理（替代理打开和操作网页的助手）使用哪个模型。
text.en: Which model the browser subagent (the helper that opens and operates web pages for the agent) uses.

browser-subagent-model.evidence: Field browser_subagent_model (enum Model) of exa.cortex_pb.BrowserSubagentToolConfig. Server value gemini-3.8-flash-low.

text.zh: 是否给代理提供 agentapi 命令行工具，用它以程序方式操作对话（例如给对话发消息）。值是 JSON，空值表示用内置设置。
text.en: Whether the agent gets the agentapi command-line tool, to act on conversations from a program (for example, send a message to a conversation). JSON value; empty means the built-in setting.

cascade-agent-api-config.evidence: Proto AgentApiConfig {enabled} in CascadeConfig.agent_api_config. Prompt text: 'You have access to the Agent API CLI tool: agentapi'. Sidecar code: 'Exposes APIs to interact with the Antigravity Agent API (via agentapi CLI)'.

text.zh: 客户端没有代码读取这个开关：名字只出现在程序内置的默认值表里，改了不起作用。
text.en: No client code reads this flag. The name occurs only in a built-in table of default values, so a change has no effect.

cascade-conversation-history-config.evidence: Only occurrence: quoted key in the embedded default-flag JSON. No bare constant; not in ui_all.txt or app.asar. The feature (ConversationHistoryConfig: recent conversations for the agent) exists, but main.js sends conversationHistoryConfig:{} and no code reads the flag.

text.zh: 从对话中自动整理「知识条目」，以后的对话会先查这些条目。JSON 里还设生成间隔等。
text.en: Automatically distills knowledge items from conversations; later conversations check these items first. The JSON also sets how often they are generated.

cascade-knowledge-config.evidence: Proto KnowledgeConfig {enabled, model, max_context_tokens, min_turns_between_knowledge_generation, max_knowledge_items, ...}. Prompt text: 'Knowledge Items (KIs) - Curated, distilled knowledge on specific topics. Always check KIs first.' Server value has enabled false.

text.zh: 代理改文件时改用按行号编辑的 sed 式工具，而不是查找替换文本的工具。
text.en: The agent edits files with a sed-style tool that works by line numbers, instead of the find-and-replace tool.

cascade-use-sed-edit-tool.evidence: CodeToolConfig.use_sed_edit. Tool sed_file with prompt 'make edits from BOTTOM of file to TOP ... Only reference line numbers you have actually viewed'. Log 'sed edit on %s'.

text.zh: 选用哪一套长对话压缩设置。现在的值 claude-1m_840k 让 1M 上下文的 Claude 模型到约 84 万 token 才压缩历史（默认约 25.6 万）。
text.en: Selects the set of settings for compacting long conversations. The current value claude-1m_840k lets Claude models with a 1M context compact history at about 840k tokens (default about 256k).

checkpoint-variant.evidence: Embedded per-model defaults: CASCADE_USE_EXPERIMENT_CHECKPOINTER has max_token_limit 256000; the variant key CASCADE_USE_EXPERIMENT_CHECKPOINTER/claude-1m_840k has max_token_limit 840000. Function model_config.CheckpointVariantKey.

text.zh: 每次上传遥测日志的大小上限，单位 MiB。
text.en: Maximum size of one telemetry log upload, in MiB.

clearcut-external-max-bytes-per-upload-m.evidence: Bare constant. Clearcut is the telemetry log client in language_server ('Clearcut dropped %d events because the upload buffer was full'). Unit and meaning from the name.

text.zh: Settings → Appearance → Advanced Settings → Chat Layout 里多出「Markdown artifact width」，可选 Default、Wide 或 Fill。
text.en: Adds "Markdown artifact width" to Settings → Appearance → Advanced Settings → Chat Layout, with the choices Default, Wide and Fill.

configure-artifact-width.evidence: main.js: markdownConfiguration.configureArtifactWidth makes the artifactWidth setting visible. Curated feature artifact-width, tested on 2.35.1.

text.zh: 客户端没有代码读取这个开关：名字只出现在内置的默认值表里，对应的配置项也已从程序中删除。
text.en: No client code reads this flag. The name occurs only in a built-in table of default values, and the matching setting was removed from the program.

context-engine-config.evidence: Only occurrence: quoted key in the embedded default-flag JSON (value {}). No bare constant; not in ui_all.txt or app.asar. context_engine_config is listed as a reserved (deleted) field name in a proto descriptor.

text.zh: 选择上下文窗口大小的功能。对外版本没有带这个组件，打开没有效果。
text.en: Lets you choose the size of the context window. The public build does not include this component, so it has no effect.

context-window-selector.evidence: main.js: contextWindowSelector is gated by {customFlag, userCohort:["google"]}, and both readers (pYb and the send path) also need uK()?.contextWindow !== void 0; the external build bindings set contextWindow: void 0, so even User type Google does not help.

text.zh: 后台性能剖析每次采集 CPU 数据多少秒。性能剖析会定期采集并上传数据，要另开 enable-continuous-pprof。
text.en: How many seconds each CPU capture of the background profiling lasts. The profiling captures and uploads data from time to time; it needs enable-continuous-pprof.

continuous-pprof-cpu-duration-seconds.evidence: Bare constant. Strings: 'Starting continuous pprof profiling background workers...', 'Capturing and uploading %s profile...', 'Continuous pprof profiling is disabled.'. The exact meaning comes from the name.

text.zh: 后台性能剖析每隔多少分钟采集一次 CPU 数据。
text.en: How many minutes pass between CPU captures of the background profiling.

continuous-pprof-cpu-interval-minutes.evidence: Bare constant. Strings: 'Starting continuous pprof profiling background workers...', 'Capturing and uploading %s profile...', 'Continuous pprof profiling is disabled.'. The exact meaning comes from the name.

text.zh: 后台性能剖析每隔多少分钟采集一次内存分配（heap）数据。
text.en: How many minutes pass between heap (memory allocation) captures of the background profiling.

continuous-pprof-heap-interval-minutes.evidence: Bare constant. Strings: 'Starting continuous pprof profiling background workers...', 'Capturing and uploading %s profile...', 'Continuous pprof profiling is disabled.'. The exact meaning comes from the name.

text.zh: 后台性能剖析每隔多少分钟检查一次内存用量。
text.en: How many minutes pass between memory-use checks of the background profiling.

continuous-pprof-mem-check-interval-minu.evidence: Bare constant. Strings: 'Starting continuous pprof profiling background workers...', 'Capturing and uploading %s profile...', 'Continuous pprof profiling is disabled.'. The exact meaning comes from the name.

text.zh: 内存用量过高触发一次采集后，至少隔多少分钟才会再次触发。
text.en: After high memory use triggers a capture, the minimum number of minutes before it can trigger again.

continuous-pprof-mem-cooldown-minutes.evidence: Bare constant. Strings: 'Starting continuous pprof profiling background workers...', 'Capturing and uploading %s profile...', 'Continuous pprof profiling is disabled.'. The exact meaning comes from the name.

text.zh: 后台程序的内存用量超过多少 GiB 时，额外采集一次内存数据。
text.en: Memory use, in GiB, above which the background program takes an extra memory capture.

continuous-pprof-mem-threshold-gib.evidence: Bare constant. Strings: 'Starting continuous pprof profiling background workers...', 'Capturing and uploading %s profile...', 'Continuous pprof profiling is disabled.'. The exact meaning comes from the name.

text.zh: 给对话套用某个试验中的代理变体。空值表示不套用。
text.en: Applies an experimental agent variant to conversations. Empty means none.

contrib-experiment-variant.evidence: Bare constant. Strings 'unknown contrib variant %q', 'applying contrib variant %q: %w'; CLI help 'Forces a contrib experiment variant (see cortex/core/contrib) for every conversation'. Battle mode also applies contrib variants per arm.

text.zh: 让同时工作的多个代理更方便地互相协调。
text.en: Makes it easier for several agents that work at the same time to coordinate with each other.

convenient-multi-agent-coordination.evidence: Only a bare constant; no related strings or functions found. Description from the name only.

text.zh: 统计各对话占用的内存并上报遥测的间隔，单位分钟（要先开 enable-conversation-memory-monitor）。
text.en: Minutes between samples of the memory that each conversation uses; the samples are reported as telemetry (needs enable-conversation-memory-monitor).

conversation-memory-sample-interval-minu.evidence: language_server functions Server.conversationMemorySampleInterval, CascadeManager.SampleAndReportConversationMemory; event CONVERSATION_MEMORY_SAMPLE; log 'Starting 1P conversation memory monitor background worker'.

text.zh: 代理每一步前后给工作区文件拍快照；把对话回退到某一步时，按快照精确恢复文件。
text.en: Takes snapshots of the workspace files before and after each agent step. When you revert a conversation to a step, the files are restored exactly from the snapshot.

cortex-snapshot-recording.evidence: CascadeConfig.cortex_snapshot_recording. Strings 'Failed to record before snapshot', 'no snapshot records the exact state at the requested step', 'failed to create snapshot recorder in constructRevertExecutor: %v. Falling back to tool-level revert.'

text.zh: 撤销对话的某一步时，把整个工作区恢复到那一步的状态，而不只撤回代理改过的文件。这期间其他来源的改动也会被一起回退。
text.en: When you undo a conversation step, restores the whole workspace to its state at that step, not only the files that the agent changed. Changes from other sources in the meantime are reverted too.

cortex-snapshot-revert.evidence: main.js: TZ("cortex-snapshot-revert") in the Confirm Undo dialog switches the text to "Undo restores your entire workspace to its state at this point" and warns that other files may be affected. language_server has a standalone string for it.

text.zh: 代理提示词里留给技能、工作流、子代理和 MCP 工具说明的 token 上限，超出的部分会被截短。
text.en: Token limit for the descriptions of skills, workflows, subagents and MCP tools in the agent's prompt. Content over the limit is shortened.

customization-token-budget.evidence: CascadePlannerConfig.customization_token_budget. Built-in docs: rules have their own 20,000-token budget, 'separate from the customization budget for skills, workflows, subagents, and MCP tools'. customizations.computeTruncatedCustomizations.

text.zh: 在后台试调新的额度查询接口，结果不显示，只用于对比测试。
text.en: Calls the new quota status service in the background. The result is not shown; it is only for comparison tests.

dark-launch-aicode-quota-status.evidence: Strings 'Shadow mode AICode FetchQuotaStatus changed: %t -> %t', 'Making AI Code FetchQuotaStatus request to: %s'.

text.zh: 对话的步骤记录存在本地数据库里；这里设从库里读出的模型生成信息在内存中缓存多少秒。
text.en: Conversation steps are stored in a local database. This sets how many seconds the model generation data read from it stays cached in memory.

dbtrajectory-gen-metadata-cache-ttl-seco.evidence: Bare constant. dbtrajectory is the SQLite store of conversation steps ('dbtrajectory: failed to save step %d', 'load gen metadata %d', lazy step loading). The TTL meaning comes from the name.

text.zh: 从本地数据库读出的对话步骤在内存中缓存多少秒。
text.en: How many seconds conversation steps read from the local database stay cached in memory.

dbtrajectory-step-cache-ttl-seconds.evidence: Bare constant. dbtrajectory is the SQLite store of conversation steps ('dbtrajectory: failed to save step %d', 'load gen metadata %d', lazy step loading). The TTL meaning comes from the name.

text.zh: 内置的 deepagent 子代理（规划、实现并验证复杂编码任务）使用哪个试验分组。空值表示默认。
text.en: Which experiment group the built-in deepagent subagent (it plans, builds and verifies complex coding tasks) uses. Empty means the default.

deepagent-arm.evidence: Bare constant. 'Experimental. Invoke the deep agent to plan, build, verify complex coding tasks.'; functions config.deepAgent, config.DeepAgentControl, config.candidateAgentArm; related flag enable-deepagent.

text.zh: 多代理协作（蜂群）时，子代理发起的交互请求默认最多等多少秒。
text.en: In multi-agent work (swarm), the default number of seconds to wait for an interaction that a subagent requests.

default_subagent_interaction_timeout_sec.evidence: Bare constant, read through config.ExperimentNumber; used by nativeswarm.(*manageSwarmTool).subagentInteractionTimeout.

text.zh: 逐步停用「临时提醒消息」，即系统插进对话、提醒代理注意事项的消息。
text.en: Phases out ephemeral messages: reminders that the system adds to the conversation for the agent.

deprecate-ephemeral-messages.evidence: Bare constant. Prompt text: 'The following is an <EPHEMERAL_MESSAGE> not actually sent by the user. It is provided by the system as a set of reminders...'. The effect of 'deprecate' is inferred from the name.

text.zh: 在输入框里插入工作流时，提示工作流已由技能取代，并提供按钮用 /migrate-workflows 把它们迁移成技能。
text.en: When you insert a workflow into the input box, shows a banner that skills replace workflows, with a button that migrates them through /migrate-workflows.

deprecate-workflows.evidence: main.js: dcd("deprecate-workflows") enables the workflow deprecation banner (fcd), shown when the editor holds a recipe (workflow) item; Migrate inserts "/migrate-workflows migrate my existing workflows to skills".

text.zh: 关掉命令安全检查：代理运行命令前不再由它评估风险，少了一道防护。
text.en: Turns off the command safety check, which rates the risk of a command before the agent runs it. This removes one safety layer.

disable-command-assessor.evidence: Bare constant. CommandAssessorConfig with policy_guardian_config; hooks cortex/core/pretoolhooks/command_assessor_hook and posttoolhooks; PolicyGuardian strings 'Irreversible action needs user confirmation', 'vet_irreversible'. enable-command-assessor is on by default.

text.zh: 客户端没有按这个名字读取开关：程序里只有写法不同的同名配置字段（disable_loop_detection），改了不起作用。
text.en: The client does not read a flag by this name: the programs contain only a config field with another spelling (disable_loop_detection), so changing it has no effect.

disable-loop-detection.evidence: Kebab name not in the client; only proto field CascadePlannerConfig.disable_loop_detection (with loop_error_model_message) and strings 'Loop Detected', '[ignoring loop detection]'. The link from the flag to this field is by spelling only. Hidden by the main session: flags are looked up by their exact name (sibling fields fed from flags have their kebab literal); only the proto field spelling exists.

text.zh: 看名字是不让代理使用搜索类工具。客户端里没有这个名字，但有能拼出它的模板 disable-%s-%s，所以保留。
text.en: Judging by the name, it stops the agent from using search tools. The client does not contain the name, but it has the template disable-%s-%s that can build it, so it is kept.

disable-search-tools.evidence: The name occurs in no client program. language_server contains the format string "disable-%s-%s" (next to review_effort and pre_tool_hook in the string table), which can build it. No other removed name matches a template.

text.zh: 只在 Google 内部有用：它处理 Google 内部的 LOAS2 登录凭据。
text.en: Useful only inside Google: it handles Google-internal LOAS2 credentials.

disable-stained-loas2-creds.evidence: LOAS2 is Google's internal authentication system. language_server strings '/run/credentials-cache/loas-' and 'stained_creds_guidance'. No use outside Google found.

text.zh: 每条回复下面多一个美元符号按钮，点开显示这一轮的 token 数和累计数（输入、从缓存读出的部分、输出、思考）。旁边按公开 API 价格估算的费用，在 2.35.1 上实测的三个模型都显示 $0.0000。

enable-cost-accumulator.evidence: language_server: CascadeManager.shouldEnableCostAccounting (checks only this flag), agentexecutor.constructAccumulators -> ConversationCostSummary. main.js: IYc renders turn/cumulative tokens and estimatedCostUsd next to the feedback buttons, 'Pricing is based on public API pricing'.

text.zh: 只对 Google 员工有效：在侧面板里预览 Google 内部代码审查工具 Critique 的链接。

enable-critique-preview.evidence: main.js: critiquePreview is gated by customFlag + userCohort:["google"] + host web.desktop; its value is buildBindings.critique.preview, and the shipped build sets critique: void 0.

enable-customization-kind-hooks.evidence: language_server: config.applyCustomizationDiscoveryOverrides and customizations.gateKinds build the name from the literal prefix 'enable-customization-kind-' plus the kind (rule, workflow, skill, agent, plugin, hooks, mcp).

enable-customization-kind-plugin.evidence: language_server: config.applyCustomizationDiscoveryOverrides and customizations.gateKinds build the name from the literal prefix 'enable-customization-kind-' plus the kind (rule, workflow, skill, agent, plugin, hooks, mcp).

enable-customization-kind-rule.evidence: language_server: config.applyCustomizationDiscoveryOverrides and customizations.gateKinds build the name from the literal prefix 'enable-customization-kind-' plus the kind (rule, workflow, skill, agent, plugin, hooks, mcp).

enable-customization-kind-skill.evidence: language_server: config.applyCustomizationDiscoveryOverrides and customizations.gateKinds build the name from the literal prefix 'enable-customization-kind-' plus the kind (rule, workflow, skill, agent, plugin, hooks, mcp).

text.zh: 是否发现和加载工作流。关掉后代理用不到你定义的工作流。

enable-customization-kind-workflow.evidence: language_server: config.applyCustomizationDiscoveryOverrides and customizations.gateKinds build the name from the literal prefix 'enable-customization-kind-' plus the kind (rule, workflow, skill, agent, plugin, hooks, mcp).

enable-customization-load-error-notice.evidence: language_server: (*Server).GetCustomizationStates reads it and adds collected load errors. main.js: Obd shows 'A customization failed to load' / 'N customizations failed to load' with path and errorDetail, dismissable.

text.zh: 客户端程序里没有这个开关名，只有一个同名的内部配置字段；同一配置里受开关控制的其他字段都按原名读取开关，所以改它不起作用。
text.en: The client programs do not contain this flag name, only an internal config field with a similar name. The sibling fields of that config that flags control read their flags by the exact name, so changing this flag has no effect.

enable-daemon-commands.evidence: No 'enable-daemon-commands' anywhere; only proto field enable_daemon_commands (RunCommandToolConfig, BashTool: 8 in language_server, 8 in agy CLI). Siblings enable_pty, enable_timeout_notification, persistent terminals are set from literal flags enable-pty, enable-timeout-notification, enable-persistent-terminals in getToolConfigOverrides.

text.zh: 增加一个实验性的「深度代理」子代理，用来规划、实现并严格验证复杂的编码和研究任务。
text.en: Adds an experimental deep agent subagent. It plans, builds and rigorously verifies complex coding and research tasks.

enable-deepagent.evidence: language_server: config.deepAgent reads it; descriptions 'Experimental. Deep reasoning agent for complex coding and research projects that need planning and rigorous verification.' and 'Invoke the deep agent to plan, build, verify complex coding tasks.'

text.zh: 在 Settings 里显示 Developer 页，里面有功能环境覆盖和 Custom Flags 列表，可以在客户端里逐个覆盖界面开关。
text.en: Shows the Developer page in Settings. It has a feature environment override and a Custom Flags list, where you can override interface flags one by one inside the app.

enable-developer-mode.evidence: main.js: developerMode feature (runtimeEnvironmentOverride, featureFlagOverrides, workspaceUriSwitcher); with it the UI reads jetski.developer.customFlagOverrides. Curated group developer-mode, seen on 2.35.1.

text.zh: Settings → General → Voice mode 里多出「Dictation languages」，可以限定听写识别的语言；听写改用新的处理流程。
text.en: Adds "Dictation languages" under Settings > General > Voice mode, to limit the languages that dictation recognizes. Dictation also uses a new processing flow.

enable-dictation-rework.evidence: main.js: settings item dictationLanguages becomes visible and feature dictationRework is enabled by this flag. Curated group dictation-rework; the setting was seen on 2.35.1.

text.zh: 代理在项目的子目录里工作时，也会发现并加载那个目录里的规则等自定义文件。
text.en: When the agent works in a subfolder of the project, it also finds and loads rules and other customization files in that folder.

enable-directory-local-discovery.evidence: language_server: read in config.buildDefaultAgent, which also sets up the directory_customizations pre-hook (prehooks.newDirectoryCustomizationsHook). Link between the two inferred.

text.zh: 在侧面板查看文件时，文件侧栏多出「Artifacts」一栏和「Filter files...」筛选框，还启用新版文件查看器的其他功能，例如 Alt+Z 切换自动换行。
text.en: When you view a file in the side panel, the file sidebar gets an "Artifacts" section and a "Filter files..." box. It also turns on other parts of the new file viewer, for example Alt+Z to toggle word wrap.

enable-enhanced-file-viewer.evidence: main.js: enhancedFileViewer feature, the toggleFileWordWrap keybinding (Alt+Z) and fileTokenization are gated by this flag. Curated group file-pane-sidebar, seen on 2.35.1.

text.zh: 连接企业版的云端后端，在项目列表里显示企业版的云端项目和其中的对话（代理在云端运行）。
text.en: Connects to the enterprise cloud backend and shows enterprise cloud projects and their conversations (agents that run in the cloud) in the project list.

enable-enterprise-remote-ai.evidence: main.js: feature remoteAi.enterprise; when true the project service opens projectUpdatesStream({backend:3}) and keeps enterprise projects (backendType 3) in the sidebar. Forced off on the Gemini app host.

text.zh: 客户端里没有读取这个开关名的代码，改了不会生效。
text.en: No code in the client reads this flag name, so changing it has no effect.

enable-fast-output-close.evidence: Kebab name absent from every client program; only the protobuf field RunCommandToolConfig.enable_fast_output_close matched (descriptor, struct tag, getter). Sibling fields fed from flags (enable-pty, enable-timeout-notification) have their kebab literal in language_server; this one has none.

text.zh: 这个名字只出现在客户端内置的默认值表里，没有任何代码读取它，改了不会生效。

enable-feature-manager-keybindings.evidence: language_server: 4 hits, all inside the embedded Mendel defaults blob (base + CLI/IDE/SDK subclient sections, offset ~156.69M); no standalone literal, no camel/snake variant; absent from UI scripts and app.asar.

text.zh: 只对 Google 内部的 Fig 版本控制有用；界面里对应的功能只对 Google 员工开放。

enable-fig-vcs-ui.evidence: main.orig.js: figVcsUiStrategy is gated by runtimeGating {userCohort:["google"]} only, no customFlag. The flag name occurs in language_server only inside the embedded defaults blob.

text.zh: 在对话的侧面板标签栏里固定一个「Files」标签，用来浏览工作区的文件。2.35.0 上实测没有看到这个标签。
text.en: Adds a fixed "Files" tab to the side panel of a conversation, to browse the files of the workspace. A test on 2.35.0 did not show the tab.

enable-file-explorer-tab.evidence: main.js 2.35.1: fileExplorerTab.isEnabled adds the persistent side-panel tab id fileExplorer (title "Files", "Workspace File Explorer", renderer present). README: no entry seen on 2.35.0.

text.zh: 文件查看器支持用键盘导航。按界面代码，还要在开发者设置页的 Feature Environment Override 里把 User type 设成 Google 才会出现，没有实测。

text.zh: 可以从对话里较早的某一步分叉，而不只是从最新一步。要和对话分叉一起打开。

enable-fork-at-historical-step.evidence: main.js: conversationForkingHistoricalStep; mXc returns no fork targets for a historical step unless it is on. Part of curated group conversation-forking.

text.zh: 只在 Google 内部的 ABFS（Android/Fuchsia 构建文件系统）工作区里有用：分叉时可以新建一个工作区。

enable-fork-in-new-abfs-workspace.evidence: main.js: conversationForkingNewABFSWorkspace adds "Fork in New Workspace" only when the workspace path is an ABFS mount (Ula: /tmp/abfs-*, /var/tmp/abfs-*; labels ABFS-Android/ABFS-Fuchsia, /google/abfs/mounts).

text.zh: 只在 Google 内部的 CitC 工作区里有用：分叉时可以新建一个 CitC 工作区。

text.zh: 分叉对话时多出「Fork in Shared Workspace」：共用同一个仓库，另建一个独立的工作副本（worktree），未提交的改动不带过去。

enable-fork-in-new-worktree.evidence: main.js: conversationForkingNewWorktree enables fork target "Fork in Shared Workspace" ("Shares this repository, with a working copy of its own. Uncommitted changes stay behind."). Part of curated group conversation-forking.

text.zh: 对话分叉的一部分：分叉出的对话记住它来自哪个对话，界面上显示「Forked from …」。
text.en: Part of conversation forking: a forked conversation remembers which conversation it came from, and the interface shows "Forked from …".

enable-fork-provenance.evidence: language_server reads the flag. Trajectory proto has fork_parent_conversation_id; main.orig.js shows a 'Forked from ${title}' chip when forkParentConversationId is set. Link between flag and field inferred from the name.

text.zh: 只在 Google 内部版本里有用：网页版界面的一种内部日志上报，对外发布的客户端没有这部分。

text.zh: 只对 Google 内部的 Git-on-Borg（CoG 工作区）有用；界面里对应的功能只对 Google 员工开放。

text.zh: 代理可以调用一个专门生成和编辑图片的子代理。

enable-vscode-injection-removal.evidence: language_server: 1 occurrence(s), all inside the embedded flag-defaults JSON (~156.68M); 0 in any spelling elsewhere in language_server, ui_all.txt, app.asar and the agy-desktop-* helpers.

text.zh: 改变内置浏览器网页在窗口里的叠放方式：网页放在界面下层，从界面留出的位置透出来。要等下次新开窗口（一般是再重启一次）才生效。
text.en: Changes how built-in browser pages are layered in the window: the page sits below the app interface and shows through a gap in it. It applies to the next new window, usually after one more restart.

enable-wcv-three-layer-stack.evidence: app.asar: WCV_THREE_LAYER_STACK_FLAG; startMendelFlagSync stores the GetMendelFlags value in app storage; isWcvThreeLayerStackEnabled is read when a Hub window with the built-in browser is created (clipView, catcherWcv, curtain, [data-browser-hole]).

text.zh: 给代理插一条提醒：一次并行发出所有互不相关的搜索和读写，不重复搜索已知内容，减少来回轮数。
text.en: Adds a reminder for the agent: send all independent searches, reads and edits in parallel in one turn, and do not repeat searches, so that fewer turns are needed.

enable-work-efficiently-reminder.evidence: language_server: literal; prehooks.newWorkEfficientlyReminderHook; reminder text 'Reminder: work efficiently. In this turn, issue in parallel every independent search, read and edit or write you need next.'

text.zh: 按文件夹记录你是否信任它；不受信任的项目里自带的自定义内容（如规则、钩子、MCP）会先被拦下，等你确认。
text.en: Keeps a record of which folders you trust. In an untrusted project, the customizations that it brings (such as rules, hooks and MCP servers) are blocked until you review them.

enable-workspace-trust.evidence: language_server: literal; strings 'workspace trust: failed to write the trust file', 'Workspace trust: cannot list blocked items for project %q', 'Failed to create customization manager to check %q for review'.

text.zh: 强制使用默认的权限预设，你为对话另选的权限预设不生效。
text.en: Forces the default permission preset. A permission preset that you choose for a conversation is not used.

enforce-default-permission-preset.evidence: language_server: one literal; permission preset code exists (admincontrols IsPermissionPresetLocked, applyPermissionPresetCeiling), but no string ties it to this flag. Meaning from the name.

text.zh: 强制关闭客户端的遥测上报。
text.en: Forces the telemetry upload of the client off.

enforce-telemetry-disabled.evidence: language_server: one literal; telemetry-off code exists (CodeAssistClient.persistTelemetryDisabled, isTelemetryDisabledPersisted), but no string ties it to this flag. Meaning from the name.

text.zh: 新用户第一次使用时，把默认的权限预设设为「自动」（Auto）。
text.en: Sets the default permission preset of a new user to Auto when they first use the app.

enroll-new-users-in-auto-mode.evidence: language_server: literal; 'failed to enroll new user in Auto permission preset: %v'; SeedAutoPermissionPreset. Defaults table: base true, CLI/IDE/SDK null.

text.zh: 代理的系统提示改用通用版本：把它介绍为通用助手而不是编程助手，并去掉一些只针对写代码的要求。
text.en: Uses the general version of the agent's system prompt: it presents the agent as a general assistant instead of a coding assistant and drops some rules that are only about coding.

generic-system-prompt.evidence: language_server: prompt templates '{{if .ExperimentEnabled "generic-system-prompt"}}You are Antigravity, a powerful agentic AI assistant{{else}}... AI coding assistant'; it also drops 'Code changes formatted as diffs' and the comment-keeping rule.

text.zh: 只在网页版里、并且只对 Google 内部账号生效，桌面端打开没有效果。
text.en: It works only in the web version and only for Google accounts. In the desktop app, turning it on has no effect.

google-workspace-mentions.evidence: Only gating: {host:[Wi.Web.Desktop],userCohort:["google"],customFlag:"google-workspace-mentions"} -> enableGoogleWorkspaceMentions; the desktop host is Wi.Electron. 2 occurrences of the quoted name: this gating and the dev-mode default flag list.

text.zh: 开子代理工具的设置（JSON）：enabled 决定代理能否开子代理，always_inherit_model 决定子代理是否总沿用当前对话的模型。
text.en: Settings (JSON) of the tool that starts subagents: enabled decides whether the agent can start subagents; always_inherit_model decides whether subagents always use the model of the conversation.

invoke-subagent-config.evidence: language_server: literal; InvokeSubagentToolConfig.GetEnabled and GetAlwaysInheritModel; tool invoke_subagent. Defaults table: base has this value, IDE/SDK null.

text.zh: 让代理以「自主模式」工作：不停下来问你，独立做完任务。对外版本的界面没有这个模式的开关。
text.en: Lets the agent work in autonomous mode: it does not stop to ask you and finishes the task on its own. The public build of the interface has no switch for this mode.

jetski-autonomous-mode.evidence: language_server: literal; prompts use .IsAutonomous ('The user is not available to respond'). main.orig.js: feature autonomousMode exists only if buildBindings.autonomousMode is set; this build passes autonomousMode: void 0 (appType external).

text.zh: 代理可以在回复里直接嵌入它生成的可交互 HTML 小部件（生成式界面）。

text.zh: 在代理的系统提示里加一段，鼓励它需要图示时用 generative_ui 技能做可交互的 HTML 小部件。要同时开着 jetski-generative-ui。

jetski-generative-ui-prompt.evidence: language_server: template {{if and (.ExperimentEnabled "jetski-generative-ui") (.ExperimentEnabled "jetski-generative-ui-prompt") (.BuiltinSkillMounted "generative_ui")}} '## Interactive HTML Widgets'.

text.zh: 服务端用来停用问题插件的名单，按插件市场、插件 ID 和版本指定。

text.en: Settings of the safety review of agent actions (Policy Guardian): whether it runs, and whether actions that cannot be undone are judged first and then need your confirmation.

policy-guardian-config.evidence: value has allowed, deployment, enable_irreversible_vetting, enable_reversibility_adjudication; language_server: '[PolicyGuardian] vet_irreversible: reversibility adjudicator...', 'Irreversible action needs user confirmation'.
